evidence_metric: pair_degree_in_newMedium.txt (proxy for available comparison evidence, NOT raw AOL frequency)
interpretation_caveat: pair_degree here counts how many (tail,head) rows a query has in newMedium.txt, which reflects how many head queries shared a clicked URL with it under the original method -- it is a proxy for available evidence density, not the query's raw AOL search frequency (which is not recoverable, see docs/DATA_PROVENANCE.md).
